title: geo-score report comparison
description: What `geo-score diff BEFORE AFTER --format json` prints: two level-1 reports (schema/report.v2.json) of one rubric version, compared check by check. Added in 1.5.0. Not a report, and never stored by the tool. Two reports that sampled different pages mix change on the site with sampling; `same_pages` says which case this is.

tool.description: The release that made the comparison. Each report's own tool is in before.tool and after.tool.

rubric_version.description: The rubric both reports were scored against. Reports of two rubric versions are refused (exit 2), never compared.

within_spread.description: True when the reports sampled different pages and the score moved by 5 or less: the run-to-run spread measured in benchmark/REPRODUCIBILITY.md. Always false on the same pages.

band_fell.description: True when the band of after.normalised is lower than the band of before.normalised.

same_pages.description: True when both reports scored the same pages (a trailing slash aside), so a difference comes from the site rather than from sampling.

pages_added.description: Pages after sampled that before did not.

pages_removed.description: Pages before sampled that after did not. On a re-score of pinned pages, a page that answered with an error or a bot-challenge page this time is here.

gates_reached_zero.description: Gate checks at zero in after and not in before. A gate at zero caps the score at 40.

gates_left_zero.description: Gate checks at zero in before and not in after, including one after could not observe.

lost_points.description: Checks scored in both reports with fewer points in after (state down), bonus checks included.

regressed.description: What --fail-on-drop exits 4 on: lost_points or gates_reached_zero is not empty, or band_fell. A check that became unobservable is never a regression.

checks.description: Every check id of the rubric and its bonus checks, in rubric order, then any other id either report carries.

before.description: Points in before, or null when before did not score the check.

after.description: Points in after, or null when after did not score the check.

state.description: up, down or same when both reports scored the check; became unobservable when only before did, which is never a drop to zero; became observable when only after did; unobservable when neither did.

notes.description: Caveats for people: whether the pages differ, whether the reports come from different releases or targets. Wording may change in any release.

file.description: The report file as given; null for the run that --baseline compares against its baseline.

tool.description: The report's own tool, or null when it does not state one. When before and after differ, part of the difference may come from the tool: a release can move a score on its own.

pages.description: How many pages the report scored (its sampled_urls).
